question: Which band just fired a founding member, then deleted the post?
story: Slipknot just fired one of their own, told the entire world, and deleted the post minutes later. According to TMZ, Loudwire and Kerrang, the band posted a statement on August fourteenth that read, effective immediately, Slipknot will no longer be associated with Sid Wilson. We wish him the best in his future endeavors. That was the whole thing. No reason. No explanation. Then it vanished off their page. Here is the backstory. TMZ reportedly broke the news that Wilson was out back on July thirty first, and the band said nothing at all for two full weeks. Reports say sources pointed to his behavior toward his bandmates, though the band has never confirmed that publicly. Guitarist Jim Root reportedly told fans to wait until there was more information. Wilson joined in nineteen ninety eight and played on every album they ever made. Almost thirty years, ended by a post that no longer exists.
